key_errors:
CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 (target_link_libraries):
  Target "openvino_intel_gpu_plugin" of type MODULE_LIBRARY may not be linked
  into another target.
root_cause: The CMake configure step fails because plugin targets (openvino_auto_plugin, openvino_intel_gpu_plugin, openvino_intel_cpu_plugin, etc.) are MODULE_LIBRARY type, which cannot be linked into other targets via target_link_libraries. This is triggered in cmake/extra_modules.cmake:186 (ov_generate_plugins_hpp). The PR changes files in src/plugins/intel_gpu which may have modified CMakeLists or plugin registration in a way that triggers this linking error on Android build targets (arm64 and x64).
reproduction_steps: Run CMake configure for Android (arm64 or x64) with the PR changes applied.
recommended_actions: Check if the PR modified any CMakeLists.txt files in intel_gpu plugin or related cmake files
Verify that plugin targets are not being linked as MODULE_LIBRARY where they should be SHARED
Review the ov_generate_plugins_hpp call in cmake/extra_modules.cmake:186 for the linking issue
prevention_strategies: Run Android build CMake configure in pre-merge CI for GPU plugin changes.
